### Load data

```{r}
raw_data_path <- "../_raw/"
data_path <- "../data/"

# Create folders automatically if they don't exist yet
if (!dir.exists(raw_data_path)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_path)
}
if (!dir.exists(data_path)) {
  dir.create(data_path)
}

base_url <- "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311689/suppl/"

# ASV table
ASV <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_ASV_table.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = ASV,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_ASV_table.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = ASV,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_asv.tsv"))

# Sample metadata
META <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_sample_metadata.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = META,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_sample_metadata.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = META,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_meta.tsv"))

# Taxonomy table
TAX <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_taxonomy_table.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = TAX,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_taxonomy_table.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = TAX,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_tax.tsv"))
```
